definition: tornadic vortex signature, abbreviated TVS, is a [Pulse-Doppler radar](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pulse-Doppler_radar) [weather radar](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Weather_radar) detected rotation [algorithm](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Algorithm) that indicates the likely presence of a strong [mesocyclone](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mesocyclone) that is in some stage of [tornadogenesis](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tornadogenesis).

tornado warning ([SAME](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Specific_Area_Message_Encoding) code: TOR) is a public warning that is issued by [weather forecasting](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Weather_forecasting) agencies to an area in the direct path of a [tornado](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tornado), or a [[Thunderstorm#Severe thunderstorms|severe thunderstorm]] capable of [producing](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tornadogenesis) one, and advises individuals in that area to [take cover](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tornado_preparedness).

tornado watch ([SAME](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Specific_Area_Message_Encoding) code: TOA) is a statement issued by [weather forecasting](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Weather_forecasting) agencies to advise the public that [atmospheric conditions](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Atmospheric_instability) in a given region may lead to the development of [tornado](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tornado)es within (or near) the region over a period of several hours.

definition: Clockwise from top: An F5 tornado going through the southeast Pinecrest Garden district of [Xenia, Ohio](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Xenia,_Ohio) on April 3rd; A mobile home that was destroyed by an F3 tornado near [Eden, Wisconsin](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eden,_Wisconsin) on April 21st; Downtown [Guin, Alabama](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Guin,_Alabama) after an F5 tornado on April 3rd; A stovepipe tornado near [Howards Grove, Wisconsin](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Howards_Grove,_Wisconsin) on April 21st; [Ted Fujita](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ted_Fujita)'s full analysis map of the 1974 Super Outbreak which occurred on April 3rd; An aerial view of [Drumright, Oklahoma](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Drumright,_Oklahoma) after an F4 tornado on June 8th.
